checks.detail: Scoped pane/display spinners use production-defined loader-rotate at 800ms linear infinite.
Scoped spinner remains animated at 1600ms linear infinite under prefers-reduced-motion; geometry and colors are unchanged.
Time, Spectrum, Spectrogram and Persistence capture current-output provider/default or rendered full-domain X/Y baselines.
Spectrum/Spectrogram/Persistence log-axis ranges remain Plotly coordinates with no raw linear reprojection; current projected units remain unchanged.
Default range/signature persists for every current signal-bearing plot type; only Time/Spectrum keep slider state.
Reset relayouts only the clicked host and changes no linked pane, settings/revision, backend/DSP state, main_signal or heatmap color range.
Only the existing loader CSS fragment and new UI-only autoscale helper transfer into current public app seams; shell and Plotly host identities remain invariant.
